newsitem.title: USA: Holder urges Telephone to strengthen board.
newsitem.headline: Holder urges Telephone to strengthen board.

text.p: Franklin Mutual Advisers Inc, a unit of Franklin Resources Inc, said Tuesday it is critical Telephone and Data Systems Inc has a strong and independent board of directors.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, FMAI said it is currently considering whether it should nominate a person for election to the board.
In the filing, Franklin reported an initial 9.8 percent stake in the company or 5,308,600 series A common shares which were purchased for investment purposes.
FMAI said it believes the per share value of all the businesses operated by Telephone and Data "far exceeds the current market price" of the common stock.

The group said the Chicago-based company should "take steps to realize the inherent value in its businesses in a manner designed to maximize shareholder values" for all the holders of the common stock.
Telephone should also cease diluting shareholder value by issuing additional common stock in making acquisitions, FMAI said in the filing.
The company is engaged in the operation of telephone, cellular and radio paging systems.
